themeHint: System follows your device and switches automatically.
languageHint: Interface language. Dates and numbers follow it too.
demoAccountNote: A fictional listener. Nothing you do here leaves this demo.
spotifyAccountNote: Signed in with your music account
syncDemo: The demo listener’s history is fixed. With your own account, Rewind saves your recent plays automatically.
syncAdded: {count, plural, =0 {No new plays} one {# new play} other {# new plays}}
loginHint: You’re asked to sign in again every six months.
syncStoppedBody: Your sign-in expired. Plays since then may be missing beyond the 50 most recent ones.
syncFailed: Sync failed. Try again in a moment.
skipThreshold: Count as a skip when shorter than
timeZone: Time zone for heatmaps and streaks
demoDataNote: Nothing about you is stored in the demo. Your edits live in this browser session and disappear when it ends.
deleteDataHint: Plays, imports, snapshots and AI generations. Your music account and playlists are untouched.
deleteDataBody: This removes {plays} plays, {imports} imports, {snapshots} playlist snapshots and {generations} AI generations. It can’t be undone.
disconnectHint: Deletes everything above and the stored login, then logs you out.
disconnectTitle: Disconnect your account and delete your data?
disconnectBody: Rewind forgets your account, history and login. Your playlists stay as they are.
